title: 第7章  收点利息，龙骨灵液！
content_zh:
“噗！”
这句话，差点将苏扬气得吐血。
他被方玄所伤、颜面尽失，体内气血翻涌。
现在又被蓝媚儿如此羞辱，更是雪上加霜，简直比抽了他几个耳光还要更加难以接受。
“好好好，今日之辱，我
苏扬深吸口气，也意识到天宝楼比他想象中还要强势，并不是如今的苏家能够得罪的。
但惹不起天宝楼，还惹不起一个毛头小子吗？
苏扬阴狠的看了一眼方玄，恨声道：“小子，你给我等着，这事没完！”
“我们走！”
说完，苏扬拖着沉重的身体，一瘸一拐走出炼丹大厅。
“谢谢您。”
苏扬一走，那名青衣侍女顿时向方玄表达感谢。
“不必，我看那家伙也挺不爽的。”
方玄淡然一笑。
他说的是实话。
他和苏清瑶之间的恩怨，可不是三两句话说得清楚的。
这苏扬又曾欺负羞辱过他，今日就当是先收取点利息。
只要给方玄找到机会，他会直接取走苏扬的性命！
但在有心人听来，却是觉得方玄是故意说给蓝媚儿听的。
目的，自然是为了索要一个炼丹名额。

“今日这第三个名额，就给这位小兄弟吧。”
一直在旁边看戏的明大师，看向方玄，说道：“大家应该没有意见吧？”
“没意见，没意见。”
众人连连摆手。
别的不说，光从方玄敢对苏扬动手这一点来看，就意味着对方的魄力，远超他们。
但有些人却面露怜悯。
今日看似出了口气，但却因此惹恼了苏扬。
得罪了苏家，下场可不会太好啊。
今后在这青阳郡，怕是寸步难行。
用脚都能想到，等待方玄的，将会是苏扬无休止的报复。
“多谢明大师和诸位好意。”
方玄说道：“在下今日不是来求丹的。”
众人一愣，纷纷看向方玄。
而明大师的眼神，突然变得意味深长起来。
“不知小弟弟，有何诉求。”
蓝媚儿抿嘴一笑，说道：“看在你刚才维护我天宝楼侍女的份上，只要不过分，姐姐都可以答应你哦。”
听着这酥麻，又极具诱惑的言语，不少人只觉得浑身骨头都轻了几斤，双腿发软。
这位天宝楼的美艳管事，还真是人间尤物啊。
“你们误会了。”
方玄哭笑不得的说道：“我只是想借贵楼的炼丹室一用而已，并无别的要求。”

借用天宝楼的炼丹室？
什么意思？
“你要自己炼丹？”
明大师却意识到什么，眼中精光一闪，说道：“难道你还是炼丹师？”
炼丹师？
怎么可能！
众人都震惊不已。
炼丹师有多稀罕难得，他们自然再清楚不过。
整个青阳郡，炼丹师的数量，都不超过一手之数。
即便是一名一品炼丹师，也是无数家族势力的座上宾。
而方玄看起来才多大？
十五岁？
还是十六岁？
如此年轻的炼丹师，他们还是第一次见到。
一时间，所有人看向方玄的眼神，都带着意味不明之色。
包括明大师和蓝媚儿。
“明大师高看我了。”
方玄却是连连摆手：“我只是借用一下炼丹师中的地心火脉，调配一些普通药液而已。”
原来如此！
闻言，众人顿时面露恍然。

心中也不由得松了口气。
某些特殊药液，确实需要地心火脉进行调配，才能发挥最大的作用。
而这种药液，功效自然是比不上丹药的，但也需要有特殊的药方才行。
“不知小友要调配何等药液。”
明大师说道：“若不嫌弃，待老夫炼完丹药之后，亲自帮小友调配如何？”
“小子先行谢过明大师了。”
方玄故作惶恐，说道：“只是一副普通的疗伤药液，岂敢劳烦明大师出手。”
“既如此，那就随你吧。”
明大师点点头，不再将此事放在心上，带着选中的三个名额，转身走进一间炼丹室。
“好了，你们三位在此等候，其余人明日再来吧。”
蓝媚儿一挥手，将没被选中的人打发走。
她看向方玄，说道：“既然小弟弟要调配药液，那么这间炼丹室再适合不过，里面的东西，一应俱全。”
“多谢。”
方玄道了声谢，顺着蓝媚儿手指的炼丹室，钻了进去。
待到炼丹室石门被关闭，蓝媚儿看向青衣侍女。
“跟我说说，这位客人今日都说了什么，做了什么。”
蓝媚儿语气漠然道：“
“是！”
青衣侍女面露紧张，连忙将和方玄的接触过程，事无巨细的告知蓝媚儿，不敢有半点隐瞒。
“气血丹乃是壮大气血的丹药，适合造血境武者服用。”

等青衣侍女说完后，蓝媚儿皱眉道：“元心丹药性温和，具有调养身心，修复经脉的功效，是不错的疗伤丹药。”
“至于这龙骨丹......”
蓝媚儿看向紧闭的炼丹室大门，嘴角再次一翘：“要么是这小子瞎说的，要么确实只是副普通药液。”
“啊？”
青衣侍女满脸惊讶。
瞎说的？
难怪她都没听过。
而炼丹师中的方玄，则是面露凝重。
“丹鼎女帝的传承，古老悠久，深不可测，甚至很多已经失传。”
方玄沉声道：“看来，以后无论是购买丹药，还是药材，还是得加倍小心才是，否则被人看出端倪，怕是会惹祸上身。”
他本以为，那龙骨丹只是一品丹药，应该随处可见。
但连天宝楼中都没有这种丹药，证明这龙骨丹并不常见，甚至是一种极为罕见的极品丹药。
就算有人听说过这种丹药，但也因为丹方失传，导致无人能够炼制。
所以他刚才才改口说自己是配制药液，而非炼丹。
当然，从某些方面说，龙骨丹确实是一种特殊药液。
收起这些杂念，方玄开始打量起炼丹室来。
炼丹室并不大，靠墙一个普通灶台。
灶台中央，是个锅炉，打造成丹炉的模样。
旁边有个凹槽，只要放入元石，就可引动地下的地心火脉，经过特殊法阵的转换后，形成可以被掌控的火焰，用来炼丹。
毕竟，炼丹师在没有凝聚出丹火之前，是无法自主炼丹的。

必须要借助地心火脉才行。
而若是收服了天地火种，不用凝聚出丹火，就可自行炼丹。
当然，这些对现在的方玄来说，太过遥远。
还是先将龙骨丹炼制出来再说吧。
从怀中摸出一块元石，方玄将其塞入灶台上的凹槽中，注入气血。
“咔咔咔！”
灶台之中，机括声响起。
元石之上，淡淡的元力散发出来。
紧接着，方玄便感应到，整个炼丹室中的空气，变得灼热起来，而且越来越烈。
“噗！”
不多时，丹炉之中冒出一朵淡黄色的火苗。
火苗的温度初始并不高，但却持续不断，为丹炉预热。
趁此机会，方玄紧闭双眼，意念进入识海，一个个金色文字不断流转。
无数炼丹手法、丹方、火候掌控、药液配比，在他意念之中飞速闪过。
方玄心神专注，瞬间剔除所有无关信息，只留下龙骨丹，也就是龙骨灵液的完整炼制之法。
“龙骨丹，又称龙骨灵液，上乘炼体药液，以龙骨草为主药，地龙根、荆棘之心为辅，辅以地心火脉文火淬炼，九九八十一转，去其杂质，取其精华，凝而成液……”
一篇完整的炼制之法，深深烙印在方玄脑海之中，仿佛已经亲手演练过千万次，熟得不能再熟。
恰在此时，丹炉预热完毕，炉内温度已然达到最佳。
方玄睁开双眼，眸中精光一闪，不再迟疑。
他手腕一翻，掌心出现一株通体淡青、叶片如龙鳞的草药。

龙骨草。
屈指轻弹，龙骨草精准落入丹炉之中。
方玄心神内敛，小心翼翼地控制着一丝气血之力，包裹住龙骨草，以地心火慢慢温养、炼化，剥离其中的杂质与糟粕。
炉火纯青，不急不躁。
等到龙骨草中的杂质被炼化得七七八八，药液渐渐浓缩之时，方玄再次抬手，将早已准备好的地龙根投入炉中。
紧接着，是荆棘之心。
三味主药，依次入炉，按照《九转丹神录》记载的顺序与火候，层层炼化，步步提纯。
时间一点点流逝。
丹炉之内，药材不断融合、精炼，杂质被一点点焚烧殆尽，只剩下一团精纯无比的药液，在炉火中缓缓旋转。
约莫半个时辰后。
丹炉之内的火焰渐渐收敛，只剩下一团婴儿拳头大小、通体漆黑的粘稠液体静静悬浮在炉底。
这液体看上去毫不起眼，甚至散发着一丝淡淡的刺鼻苦涩气息。
毫无丹药应有的清香，与街边普通的草药渣别无二致。
可方玄看到这团液体的瞬间，双眸却骤然爆发出一团炽热无比的光芒，呼吸都微微急促了几分。
这正是龙骨灵液！
这看似不起眼、甚至有些丑陋的黑乎乎液体，却是无数修士梦寐以求的炼体至宝！
有了它，方玄便能够节省大量的时间，将修为往上提升。
将龙骨灵液小心翼翼装入药瓶，不留丝毫。
看着光溜溜的丹炉，方玄犹不放心，又随便取出三种药材，将其炼化成药液，涂抹在丹炉之中。
还好之前购买药材的时候，方玄留了个心眼，故意多买了几种毫不相关的药材。

现在正好用得上。
做完这一切后，方玄便心满意足的离开炼丹室。
content_en:
"Poof!"
These words almost made Su Yang so angry that he vomited blood.
He was injured by Fang Xuan, his face was completely lost, and his blood surged in his body.
Now that he was so humiliated by Lan Meier, it was even worse. It was even more difficult to accept than a few slaps on his face.
"Okay, okay, today's humiliation, I
Su Yang took a deep breath and realized that Tianbao Tower was more powerful than he thought, and it was not something that the current Su family could offend.
But if you can't offend Tianbao Tower, how can you still offend a young boy?
Su Yang glanced at Fang Xuan viciously, and said angrily: "Boy, just wait for me, this matter is not over yet! "
"Let's go! "
After saying that, Su Yang dragged his heavy body and limped out of the alchemy hall.
"Thank you. "
As soon as Su Yang left, the maid in green clothes immediately expressed her gratitude to Fang Xuan.
"No need, I think that guy is quite unhappy too. "
Fang Xuan smiled lightly.
He told the truth.
The grudge between him and Su Qingyao cannot be explained clearly in a few sentences.
This Su Yang had bullied and humiliated him again, so today he just wanted to collect some interest.
As long as Fang Xuan is given a chance, he will directly take Su Yang's life!
But to those who are interested, they feel that Fang Xuan told Lan Meier on purpose.
The purpose is naturally to ask for a quota for alchemy.
“The third quota today will be given to this little brother. "
Master Ming, who had been watching the show, looked at Fang Xuan and said, "Everyone should have no objections, right? "
"No objection, no objection. "
Everyone waved their hands.
Not to mention anything else, just from the fact that Fang Xuan dared to attack Su Yang, it meant that the other party's courage far exceeded them.
But some showed mercy.
It seemed like he was relieved today, but it annoyed Su Yang.
If you offend the Su family, the outcome will not be too good.
From now on in Qingyang County, I'm afraid it will be difficult to move even an inch.
You can imagine with your feet that what awaits Fang Xuan will be Su Yang's endless revenge.
"Thank you Master Ming and everyone for your kindness. "
Fang Xuan said: "I'm not here to ask for elixirs today. "
Everyone was stunned and looked at Fang Xuan.
Master Ming's eyes suddenly became meaningful.
“I don’t know what you want, little brother. "
Lan Mei'er pursed her lips and smiled, and said: "For the sake of protecting my Tianbao Tower maid just now, my sister can agree to it as long as it's not too much. "
Listening to these numbing and seductive words, many people felt that all the bones in their bodies were a few kilograms lighter and their legs were weak.
This beautiful steward of Tianbao Tower is really a beauty in the world.
"You have misunderstood. "
Fang Xuan said dumbfounded: "I just want to use the alchemy room in your building, and I have no other requirements. "
Borrowing the alchemy room in Tianbao Tower?
What does it mean?
"You want to make an elixir yourself? "
Master Ming realized something, his eyes flashed, and he said: "Are you still an alchemist? "
Alchemist?
How is that possible!
Everyone was shocked.
Naturally, they knew how rare alchemists were.
In the entire Qingyang County, the number of alchemists does not exceed one hand.
Even a first-grade alchemist is a guest of countless family forces.
And how old does Fang Xuan look?
Fifteen?
Still sixteen?
This was the first time they had seen such a young alchemist.
For a moment, everyone looked at Fang Xuan with unclear meaning.
Including Master Ming and Lan Meier.
"Master Ming thinks highly of me. "
Fang Xuan waved his hands repeatedly: "I just borrowed the earth core fire vein from the alchemist to prepare some ordinary medicinal liquid. "
That’s it!
Hearing this, everyone suddenly looked surprised.
I couldn't help but feel relieved.
Some special medicinal liquids really need to be prepared by the earth's core fire veins in order to have the greatest effect.
Naturally, the efficacy of this liquid medicine is not as good as that of elixirs, but it also requires a special prescription.
"I don't knowWhat kind of medicine should I prepare? "
Master Ming said: "If you don't mind it, how about after I finish refining the elixir, how about helping me prepare it myself?" "
“Boy, I’d like to thank Master Ming in advance. "
Fang Xuan pretended to be frightened and said: "It's just an ordinary healing liquid, how dare you bother Master Ming to take action. "
“In that case, then it’s up to you. "
Master Ming nodded and no longer took the matter to heart. He turned around and walked into an alchemy room with the three selected places.
"Okay, you three are waiting here, and the rest can come back tomorrow. "
Lan Meier waved her hand and sent away those who were not selected.
She looked at Fang Xuan and said, "Since my little brother wants to prepare the medicinal solution, this alchemy room is perfect. Everything in it is available. "
"Thank you. "
Fang Xuan thanked him and followed Lan Meier's finger into the alchemy room and got into it.
When the stone door of the alchemy room was closed, Lan Meier looked at the maid in blue.
"Tell me what this guest said and did today. "
Lan Meier said in an indifferent tone: "
"Yes!"
The maid in green looked nervous, and she quickly told Lan Meier the details of her contact with Fang Xuan, not daring to hide anything.
"Qi and blood pills are pills that strengthen qi and blood and are suitable for hematopoietic realm warriors."
After the maid in blue finished speaking, Lan Meier frowned and said, "The Yuanxin Pill is mild in nature. It has the effect of recuperating the body and mind and repairing the meridians. It is a good healing pill."
"As for this Dragon Bone Pill..."
Lan Meier looked at the closed door of the alchemy room and raised the corner of her mouth again: "Either this kid is talking nonsense, or it is really just an ordinary medicine."
"Huh?"
The maid in green was full of surprise.
Nonsense?
No wonder she hasn't heard of it.
Fang Xuan, the alchemist, had a solemn expression on his face.
"The inheritance of Empress Danding is ancient and unfathomable. Many of them have even been lost."
Fang Xuan said in a deep voice: "It seems that in the future, whether you are buying elixirs or medicinal materials, you have to be more careful, otherwise you may get into trouble if someone sees the clues."
He originally thought that the Dragon Bone Pill was just a first-grade pill and should be available everywhere.
But there is no such elixir even in Tianbao Tower, which proves that this dragon bone elixir is not common, and is even an extremely rare and top-quality elixir.
Even if someone has heard of this elixir, no one can refine it because the elixir recipe has been lost.
That's why he just changed his mind and said that he was preparing medicinal liquids, not refining elixirs.
Of course, in some respects, Dragon Bone Pill is indeed a special medicinal liquid.
Putting away these distracting thoughts, Fang Xuan began to look at the alchemy room.
The alchemy room is not big, with an ordinary stove against the wall.
In the center of the stove is a boiler, shaped like a pill furnace.
There is a groove next to it. As long as the Yuan Stone is put in, the underground fire veins in the core of the earth can be triggered. After being converted by a special magic circle, a flame can be controlled to form a flame that can be used to make elixirs.
After all, an alchemist cannot make an elixir independently before condensing the elixir fire.
It must be done with the help of the earth's core fire veins.
And if you conquer the fire of heaven and earth, you can make elixirs by yourself without condensing elixir fire.
Of course, these are too far away for Fang Xuan now.
Let’s refine the Dragon Bone Pill first.
Taking out a piece of Yuan Stone from his arms, Fang Xuan stuffed it into the groove on the stove and injected it with Qi and blood.
"Kakaka!"
In the stove, the sound of machinery sounded.
On top of the Yuan Stone, a faint Yuan Power emanated.
Immediately afterwards, Fang Xuan felt that the air in the entire alchemy room became hotter and hotter.
"Poof!"
Not long after, a pale yellow flame emerged from the alchemy furnace.
The temperature of the flame is not high initially, but it continues to warm up the alchemy furnace.
Taking this opportunity, Fang Xuan closed his eyes tightly, his mind entered the sea of ​​consciousness, and the golden words continued to flow one by one.
Countless alchemy techniques, elixir recipes, fire control, and liquid medicine ratios are all here.It flashed through his mind quickly.
Fang Xuan concentrated his mind and instantly eliminated all irrelevant information, leaving only the Dragon Bone Pill, which is the complete method of refining the Dragon Bone Spirit Liquid.
"Dragon Bone Pill, also known as Dragon Bone Spirit Liquid, is a superior body refining liquid. It uses dragon bone grass as the main medicine, earth dragon root and heart of thorns as supplements, and is tempered by slow fire with the earth's core fire veins. After ninety-nine and eighty-one turns, it removes its impurities, extracts its essence, and condenses it into a liquid..."
A complete refining method was deeply imprinted in Fang Xuan's mind, as if he had practiced it thousands of times and was extremely familiar with it.
At this time, the preheating of the furnace was completed, and the temperature in the furnace had reached the optimal level.
Fang Xuan opened his eyes, his eyes flashed, and he no longer hesitated.
He turned his wrist, and a light green herb with leaves like dragon scales appeared in his palm.
Keel grass.
With a flick of his finger, the dragon bone grass accurately fell into the alchemy furnace.
Fang Xuan was restrained and carefully controlled a trace of energy and blood to wrap the dragon bone grass, slowly nourishing and refining it with the earth's core fire, and peeling off the impurities and dross.
Perfect in one's career, neither impatient nor impetuous.
When the impurities in the dragon bone grass were refined and the liquid gradually concentrated, Fang Xuan raised his hand again and threw the prepared earth dragon root into the furnace.
Next, comes Heart of Thorns.
The three main herbs are put into the furnace one after another, and are refined layer by layer and purified step by step according to the order and heat recorded in the "Nine Transformations of Dan Shen Lu".
Time passes little by little.
In the alchemy furnace, the medicinal materials are continuously fused and refined, and the impurities are burned away little by little, leaving only a ball of extremely pure liquid slowly rotating in the fire.
About half an hour later.
The flames in the alchemy furnace gradually subsided, leaving only a ball of viscous liquid the size of a baby's fist, completely black, floating quietly at the bottom of the furnace.
The liquid looked unremarkable, even exuding a faint pungent bitter smell.
There is no fragrance that elixirs should have, and it is no different from the ordinary herbal residue on the street.
But the moment Fang Xuan saw the liquid, his eyes suddenly burst into a ball of extremely hot light, and his breathing became slightly faster.
This is exactly Dragon Bone Spiritual Liquid!
This seemingly inconspicuous and even ugly black liquid is actually the body-refining treasure that countless monks dream of!
With it, Fang Xuan can save a lot of time and improve his cultivation level.
Carefully put the dragon bone spirit liquid into the medicine bottle, leaving no trace behind.
Looking at the bare alchemy furnace, Fang Xuan was still worried, so he randomly took out three medicinal materials, refined them into medicinal liquid, and applied them to the alchemy furnace.
Fortunately, when buying medicinal materials before, Fang Xuan was careful and deliberately bought a few more unrelated medicinal materials.
It comes in handy now.
After doing all this, Fang Xuan left the alchemy room with satisfaction.
